pow.python_method: sha256 over column values (exact strings; record_seq as decimal text) joined by '\n' in record_seq order
pow.r_method: sha256 over exact field bytes (record_seq as decimal text) joined by '\n' in physical record order

asnf.python_method: sha256 over column values (exact strings; record_seq as decimal text) joined by '\n' in record_seq order
asnf.r_method: sha256 over exact field bytes (record_seq as decimal text) joined by '\n' in physical record order

note: Python parses raw bytes with numpy/pyarrow and checksums values re-read from the derived Parquet; R independently parses the raw file bytes with readBin and its own hard-coded layout. Equal per-column sha256 implies identical values and order.
